title: The Notebook of Unfinished Questions
title_ja: 未解決の疑問を集めるノート

source_links.title: Original fictional lesson — project authoring provenance, not factual evidence

fact_notes: 完全オリジナルの架空事例。実在の学校・人物・調査結果を示さない。リンクは制作方針の来歴確認用。

sentences.en: In a science class, the teacher gave every student a small notebook for questions.
sentences.ja: 理科の授業で先生は生徒全員に疑問を書く小さなノートを渡しました。

sentences.en: Some students expected to receive extra homework, but the teacher did not ask them to answer everything.
sentences.ja: 追加の宿題が出ると思った生徒もいましたが、先生はすべて答えるよう求めませんでした。

sentences.en: She simply wanted them to write down things they did not yet understand.
sentences.ja: まだ理解していないことを書き留めてほしかっただけです。

sentences.en: During the first week, Yuki wrote only one question because he was afraid of making a mistake.
sentences.ja: 最初の週、ユウキは間違いを恐れて疑問を一つしか書きませんでした。

sentences.en: However, his teacher showed the class several questions from her own notebook.
sentences.ja: しかし先生は自分のノートにある疑問をいくつかクラスに見せました。

sentences.en: Some of them were about subjects she was still learning.
sentences.ja: そのいくつかは先生自身がまだ学んでいる話題についてでした。

sentences.en: Yuki began to notice more questions when he read his textbook or listened to other students.
sentences.ja: 教科書を読んだり他の生徒の話を聞いたりすると、ユウキは以前より多くの疑問に気づくようになりました。

sentences.en: Instead of trying to solve them all at once, he chose one each week to explore.
sentences.ja: すべてを一度に解決しようとする代わりに、毎週一つを選んで調べました。

sentences.en: He sometimes wrote a new question next to an earlier one after finding part of an answer.
sentences.ja: 答えの一部を見つけた後、以前の疑問の横に新しい疑問を書くこともありました。

sentences.en: At the end of the month, the notebook was not full of finished answers.
sentences.ja: 月末になってもノートは完成した答えでいっぱいではありませんでした。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Yuki could explain more clearly what he knew and what he needed to learn next.
sentences.ja: それでも、知っていることと次に何を学ぶ必要があるかをより明確に説明できました。

sentences.en: He realized that a good question could help him decide where to begin studying.
sentences.ja: よい疑問はどこから勉強を始めるか決める助けになると気づきました。

questions.prompt: What did the teacher give the students?
questions.explanation_ja: 疑問用の小さなノート。

questions.prompt: What did students need to write?
options: Things they did not yet understand
questions.explanation_ja: まだ理解していないこと。

questions.prompt: Why did Yuki write just one question initially?
options: He had lost his pencil every day
He had already learned all science
He was forbidden to ask questions

questions.prompt: What did the teacher show the class?
What did the teacher's example suggest?
options: Even a teacher can have things left to learn
Every question must be solved immediately
questions.explanation_ja: 先生自身も学びの途上にいる。

questions.prompt: When did Yuki notice more questions?
options: While reading or listening to classmates
questions.explanation_ja: 教科書や他の生徒の話。

questions.prompt: How many questions did he choose to explore each week?
What did he sometimes add after finding part of an answer?
questions.explanation_ja: さらに生まれた新しい疑問。

questions.prompt: What improved by the end of the month?
options: His awareness of what he knew and needed to learn
His ability to finish every question
His teacher's ability to grade instantly
questions.explanation_ja: 学習の現在地の説明が明確になった。

questions.prompt: What is the message of the passage?
questions.explanation_ja: 未解決の問いは学びの方向を導く。

grammar.focus: things they did not yet understand
was afraid of making a mistake

grammar.explanation_ja: to不定詞で調べる対象を表す。

paraphrases.source: She simply wanted them to write down things they did not yet understand.
paraphrases.rewrite: She asked them to record what was still unclear.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 不明なことを記録するよう求めた。

paraphrases.source: However, his teacher showed the class several questions from her own notebook.
paraphrases.rewrite: The teacher shared some of the questions she had written herself.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 先生自身の疑問を共有した。

paraphrases.source: Instead of trying to solve them all at once, he chose one each week to explore.
paraphrases.rewrite: He selected a single question to investigate each week.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 週に一つ選んで調べた。

paraphrases.source: Nevertheless, Yuki could explain more clearly what he knew and what he needed to learn next.
paraphrases.rewrite: Yuki became better at identifying what he understood and what to study next.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 理解と次の課題を明確にできた。

discourse.role_ja: 宿題の予想と実際の指示。
間違いへの不安と先生のモデル提示。
一度に全部でなく一つずつ。
未完成でも得られた学び。
